scope: Adult English grammar, reading and writing; listening/speaking deferred by owner
lesson_structure: Short explanation with context and common error

checkpoint_policy.closed_checks: At least 10 distinct reviewed questions spanning the unit objectives; never pad with aliases.
checkpoint_policy.progression: An 80% independent-check result is only a suggested review rule, not a CEFR or mastery claim.
checkpoint_policy.writing: Use task fulfilment, organisation, meaning and accuracy rubrics; no automatic writing grade from word presence.
checkpoint_policy.review: Use the existing owner-scoped review history and recency; clicking through a lesson does not demonstrate completion.

units.title: Sentence foundations
units.objective: Build complete sentences and distinguish statements, questions and commands.
units.written_task: Write and repair six complete sentences about a normal working day.
units.coverage_warning: Topic pools can mix difficulty; candidates are not an approved exercise sequence.

units.title: Identity and reference
units.objective: Use be, pronouns and possessives to introduce people and refer to things clearly.
units.written_task: Write a short introduction with unambiguous pronouns.
units.coverage_warning: Topic pools can mix difficulty; candidates are not an approved exercise sequence.

units.title: Nouns and quantity
units.objective: Choose articles, number and quantity expressions from the intended meaning.
units.written_task: Describe a workspace, its equipment and what is missing.
units.coverage_warning: Topic pools can mix difficulty; candidates are not an approved exercise sequence.

units.title: Routines and questions

units.title: Now, usually and states

units.title: Descriptions and comparisons

units.title: Plans and future reference

units.title: Ability, obligation and requests

units.title: Integrated reading and writing
units.objective: Read for meaning, select relevant evidence and produce a clear written response.
